Hymn 64: On This Day of Joy and Gladness
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Ebenezer Beesley
Lyricist/Text Author: William W. Phelps
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 64 titled "On This Day of Joy and Gladness" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Ebenezer Beesley and the lyrics were written by William W. Phelps.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
